item.title: Shake Shack: $2 Sodas, $4 Crinkle Cut Fries, $6 Shakes via App
item.guid: Shake Shack-$2 Sodas, $4 Crinkle Cut Fries, $6 Shake-2026-08-10
item.description: Order online or through the Shake Shack app at participating locations to get sodas for $2, crinkle cut fries for $4, and shakes for $6. (Ongoing)

item.title: Shake Shack: Any Custard for $3 with Code CUSTARDTIME
item.guid: Shake Shack-Any Custard for $3 with Code CUSTARDTIME-2026-08-10
item.description: Use promo code CUSTARDTIME in restaurants, online, or in the Shake Shack app to get any custard for $3. (Through August 19, 2026)

item.title: Starbucks: Free Refills on Hot and Iced Brewed Coffee and Tea
item.guid: Starbucks-Free Refills on Hot and Iced Brewed Coff-2026-08-10
item.description: Free refills of hot and iced brewed coffee and tea are back at Starbucks; you can also bring any clean reusable cup for your drink order. (Ongoing)

item.title: Wingstop: $16.99 Boneless Meal Box: 20 Wings, Large Fry, Two Dips
item.guid: Wingstop-$16.99 Boneless Meal Box: 20 Wings, Larg-2026-08-10
item.description: Get 20 boneless wings with your choice of flavors, a large fry, and two dipping sauces for $16.99 at Wingstop online or in-app. (Ongoing)

item.title: Wingstop: 16-Piece Wings plus 6-Piece Tenders plus Fries for $19.99
item.description: Bundle 16 classic or boneless wings with 6 crispy tenders and a side of fries for $19.99 via Wingstop online or app. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chili’s: 3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.99
item.guid: Chili’s-3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.-2026-08-10
item.description: Chili’s all-day 3 For Me bundles a bottomless drink, an appetizer (chips and salsa or house salad), and a full entree starting at $10.99, with $14.99 and $16.99 tiers - every day at participating locations, no membership needed. (Ongoing)
